audience: landlords and property managers who run Rentec Direct accounts

useCases.title: Find vacant properties and their rent
useCases.text: List the properties and filter them to vacant ones. Open one property to see its renters and subunits.

useCases.title: Review leases that end soon
useCases.text: List the leases with move-in and move-out dates and recurring rent. Open one lease to see its balances.

useCases.title: Check open maintenance work orders
useCases.text: List the work orders with status, property, vendor and priority. Open one work order to read its notes.

useCases.title: Log a maintenance request as a work order
useCases.text: Create a work order for a property with a priority, and an optional tenant or vendor. The tool does not send e-mail.

useCases.title: Check tenant and owner balances
useCases.text: List tenants and owners with their balances. Open one record to see its details.
